pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/metrics/index.tsx:14 The metrics here are React charts of game-design data; a case-insensitive search of sub_bestiary for judge, verdict, rubric, benchmark, scenario, golden and llm found no hits, so nothing runs a model against scenarios and the subject's precondition does not hold.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:1671 The agent under measurement gets a shell and file writes by default, with skipPermissions on, in the same tree the gates run in and where the harness keeps its state, and no write-surface enumeration or holdout was found, so a 'verified' pass cannot assert what the candidate could have edited.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:1667 By default the harness state sits inside the candidate's writable project; gate commands such as vitest run over test files in that same tree. A search of src/lib/harness, src/components/harness, src/app/api/harness and tools/pof-mcp/src for holdout or tamper guards found none.

src/lib/harness/run-diff.ts:151 The run comparison reports one unconditioned cost delta over runs that can fail or stop at the budget cap, with no both-succeeded view and no subset size, although per-area cost exists.

src/lib/harness/run-diff.ts:148 The delta compares stored rates with no instrument identity: the run row records neither passRateBasis, gate set nor model, and harness-runs-db derives passRate from plan.passingFeatures, which counts self-reported passes even though the stop condition defaults to the verified basis.
src/lib/harness/verifier.ts:119 A gate that could not run is reported as unverifiable rather than passed, keeping pass, fail and could-not-run distinct.

src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:195 Runs have a default spend ceiling checked before more sessions fire. Only the budget control was judged; the model-pinning rule is not satisfied by buildClaudeArgs, which passes no --model flag.
